title: Рубли вместо долларов и пропажа Пашки  (Rubles Instead of Dollars and Pashka's Disappearance)

segments.t: When the debt collector returns, Lyova proudly hands over the hundred thousand rubles gathered by the cooks, only for the thug to laugh and clarify that Chef Barinov owes a hundred thousand dollars. Meanwhile, Nastya brings Pashka the turtle back to work, where it promptly wanders into the kitchen.
Короче, чтобы деньги к вечеру были.
